tools.name: publish_artifact
tools.description: Publish a file or directory as a new immutable, versioned artifact and get a link the user can open in cc. The kind is inferred from the source: a .md file is markdown; a .html file, or a directory/.tar.gz with a root index.html, is a static site; anything else is a downloadable file. Pass project when called from the conductor (its own project is not a user project).

path.description: Absolute path of the file, directory or .tar.gz to publish.

title.description: Human title shown in the artifact list.

kind.description: Override the inferred kind. "app" is not supported yet; use "static".

project.description: Owning project. Defaults to the calling session's project; required from the conductor.

sessionId.description: Publishing session. Defaults to the calling session.

tools.name: update_artifact
tools.description: Publish a new version of an existing artifact from a new source. Earlier versions stay available. The source must be of the artifact's kind; the project cannot change.

path.description: Absolute path of the new source.

title.description: New title; omit to keep the current one.

kind.description: Pass the artifact's kind when the source would otherwise be inferred as another.

sessionId.description: Publishing session. Defaults to the calling session.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts, newest first, optionally for one project or kind.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Get one artifact's full record: every version with its deep link.

tools.name: delete_artifact
tools.description: Delete a whole artifact, or one version of it when version is given. The only remaining version cannot be deleted on its own.
